Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one PORTRAIT concept-art roster sheet of 15 original enemy designs for a top-down mobile survival arena game. This is a reference for later real-time 3D modeling. Exact grid 3 columns × 5 rows, 15 equally sized cells, in reading order as mapped below. Show exactly ONE full-body enemy centered in each cell, with a small clean numeric ID 01–15 at the lower left of its cell, and no other type, headings, or text. Equal padding, subtle uniform card divisions, soft shadows showing grounded support, no scenery. Unified camera per sheet: orthographic high front three-quarter view (about 50 degrees above the ground), tops and front silhouettes clearly visible, generous space above and beneath every character. Keep feet and extremities completely inside each cell. Style all 15 consistently with the direction below; all have distinct locomotion, silhouettes and silhouette-defining hardware. Every design should be recognisable at phone scale. Boss takes most of its own cell with a truly massive silhouette. Render quality like a polished game visual-development lineup. No references to existing games, IP, logo, real photographs, or provided models. Avoid similar generic rectangular bodies repeated across cells.

ART DIRECTION A — FOUNDRY AUTOMATA. Real 3D render look, sharply faceted low-poly industrial enemies from a high-end stylized action game. Precision-machined graphite steel, pale warm ceramic panels, brushed brass collars, bold vermilion enamel, narrow luminous safety indicators. Use hexagon and trapezoid construction, prominent mechanical joints, angular broad form with few seams. Premium clean engineering. Dark desaturated slate neutral card backdrop with restrained cool rim lights. Designs feel dangerous but reproducible with bevelled shapes. Example signature shapes: 01 terracotta crescent shell over exposed tripod; 02 two scythe-like ski legs beneath a light arrow frame; 03 enormous suspended fists under bridge-shaped armor; 15 black quadruped furnace with a square-in-circle molten forge on top.


Exact left-to-right cell mapping:
Row 1: 01 common melee (small simple ground pursuer); 02 scout (very light, long fast silhouette); 03 heavy melee (broad mass and blunt limbs, no cannon).
Row 2: 04 rifle shooter (single short forward gun); 05 charger (low forward wedge with two ramming points); 06 bomber (caged spherical payload, short stable feet).
Row 3: 07 healer (readable repair cross and tool arms); 08 splitter (two distinct halves with clear bright seam); 09 summoner (two forward deployment bays).
Row 4: 10 sniper (very long precision barrel and narrow body); 11 mortar (upward-angled launch tube on stable platform); 12 teleporter (broken circular coil with a central core).
Row 5: 13 buffer (tall amplifier beacon with radial fins); 14 armored (prominent front shield and protected low drive base); 15 Arena Guardian boss (huge low center with heavy radial legs and exposed top reactor).
